images.filename: Cherokee Hills Byway - Tahlonteeskee Cherokee Museum - NARA - 7717615.jpg
images.caption:
Scope and content:  The original finding aid described this photograph as:

Original Caption: The reconstructed site of the original Tahlonteeskee Cherokee Museum stands against a pale sky. In addition to the Courthouse, there is also a Council House and a Log Cabin. The area served as the Capitol of the Cherokee Nation from 1828-1839.

Location: Oklahoma

Status: Public domain.
